Subject: WINTER MEETINGS 
 
Members:
 
The BBWAA Meeting during the Winter Meetings will be at 9 a.m., PST, Tuesday, Dec. 11, in Islander Ballroom E of the Mandalay Bay Resort and Casino in Las Vegas. The 2019 winner of the J.G. Taylor Spink Award for contributions to baseball writing will be announced at the meeting. The room has been booked to us for two hours.
 
Among the issues on the agenda are the elections of national officers. 
 
If you have a topic for consideration at the meeting, please contact President Clark Spencer at clark40ball@yahoo.com or me at bbwaa@aol.com before 6 p.m. Sunday, Dec. 9.
 
 
Jack O’Connell

Subject: WINTER MEETINGS

The BBWAA Meeting during the Winter Meetings will be at 12 noon, PST, Tuesday, Dec. 9, in Harbor G in the Harbor Tower, 2nd floor, of the Manchester Grand Hyatt Hotel in San Diego. The 2015 winner of the J.G. Taylor Spink Award for contributions to baseball writing will be announced at the meeting.

Among the issues on the agenda: votes on proposals from the Membership Committee chaired by Bill Shaikin (LAA) and the Hall of Fame Voting Committee chaired by Susan Slusser (SFO) and on Internet candidates for active membership in the BBWAA.

If you have a topic for consideration at the meeting, please contact President Jesus Ortiz at Jesus.Ortiz@chron.com or Secretary-Treasurer Jack O’Connell at bbwaa@aol.com before 6 p.m. Sunday, Dec. 7.
You are also urged to view the message board on the bbwaa.com web site to familiarize yourself with past discussions.

Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Fenech, Anthony
Sent: Saturday, November 8, 2014 9:03 PM
To: Myers, Gene <gmyers@freepress.com>
Subject: Winter meetings 
 
GENE: I think I have earned the opportunity to cover the winter meetings in December.
Attached is a detailed look at what I have been doing the past three weeks.

In short, I have contacted over 60 agents of current and former Tigers and free agents. I have been persistent in that process and it paid off in one scoop (Soria's option) and could pay off in more (I was told yesterday that the Tigers have contacted lefty reliever Craig Breslow).
In my estimation, I am working harder than anybody on the Tigers' beat right now, and I am doing it while working the night shift five days a week.
Meeting these agents face-to-face would prove invaluable in taking the next step to building the network I hope to build.

From: Fenech, Anthony
Sent: Monday, December 9, 2019 6:22 PM
To: haley.kolff@detroittigers.com <haley.kolff@detroittigers.com>
Subject: Winter meetings 
 
Know you're in and out of meetings and stuff, but text me later this evening if you're around. Got something to run by you. I'm at 734-752-9667.
